mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 66 degrees with clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park and a full moon shining bright. You can spot the International Space Station passing high in the sky starting at 7:44 PM, moving from the northwest near Verona High School toward the southeast near Festival Foods. Tonight, the temperature will drop to 48 degrees with no rain predicted.

In city news, Highway M near the new Aldi site will be closed for construction from October 5 through October 7, so please follow the posted detours on Old PB and Verona Avenue. Also, remember that all city planning fees must be paid by check to the city and never via wire transfer or suspicious online portals.

There is plenty to do in our community, starting with live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus the Verona Fall Fest, all happening today. Looking ahead, tomorrow you can visit the Dane County Farmers' Market at the Capitol or catch live music at Paddy Mac's.

Regarding recent police activity, on September 10, officers responded to an in-progress burglary on Hunters Cove Way where a 19-year-old male was taken into custody after a shot was fired during the incident.
Today at the Culver's in Verona, the store is currently closed for a facility remodel, so we do not have a flavor of the day to share at this time.
